name: Claudia Carols
source:
Claudia is the uber-nerd of the school, a child genius! But despite that she seems to be easy enough to talk to as long as you have an interest in books and stories! Her meddling into dimensional space-time might cause some problems down the road....

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jagogames/the-lost-delinquents-of-rollings-high-visual-novel?ref=profile_saved_projects_live]Kickstarter[/url]]
